subject.title: feat(agents): add iteration budget for agent loop safety

question: Should `maxToolCallingRounds` permanently support only the built-in OpenClaw harness and fail before the model call whenever a configured agent selects a plugin harness?
rationale: The safe behavior is not mechanically determined: silently ignoring the setting would violate its safety promise, while failing closed can stop previously valid plugin-harness runs after an operator opts into the new setting.

options.title: Confirm strict built-in-only support
options.body: Bless the documented pre-model failure for plugin harnesses and require current-head live proof of both successful OpenClaw enforcement and the explicit unsupported-harness error.

options.title: Add a harness capability contract
options.body: Pause merge until harnesses can advertise and implement round-limit enforcement through a stable capability/API boundary.

options.title: Defer the config surface
options.body: Close or pause this branch and keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/9912 as the product-design target until cross-harness semantics are settled.

recommendation.title: Confirm strict built-in-only support
recommendation.body: Bless the documented pre-model failure for plugin harnesses and require current-head live proof of both successful OpenClaw enforcement and the explicit unsupported-harness error.

likelyOwner.reason: They already narrowed the config contract, selected the built-in-only behavior, and carried the latest runner integration commits.
